summary: Health workforce and operational efficiency represent today's dominant themes. On the clinical training front, STAT News is featuring reader opinions on medical education reform, specifically whether medical school curricula should be shortened, alongside broader healthcare workforce concerns including gaps in pediatric emergency care. On the operational side, two healthcare systems are demonstrating measurable efficiency gains through technology adoption: Owensboro Health has recovered 1,700 hours through virtual nursing implementation, while Tainan Municipal Hospital has set an aggressive target of 90 percent AI utilization across operations. Separately, STAT News is publishing an opinion piece arguing that the Kennedy administration and its Make America Healthy Again (MAHA) initiative could build public trust and credibility by visibly promoting the MMR vaccine rather than pursuing broader anti-vaccine messaging.
